subject: Upgrading R version in existing packrat project

messages.author: 6b40168107918193
messages.subject: Upgrading R version in existing packrat project
parts:
Hi,

What is the best way to upgrade the R version (for e.g. 3.2.2 --> 3.3.0) in an existing packrat project (under windows).

Thanks,
Adiel

messages.author: ab0d2be2ea8dabe8
messages.subject: Re: Upgrading R version in existing packrat project
parts:
Hi Adiel,

The simplest way would be to simply launch a new version of R within that project -- packrat will detect that a new version of R is being used (and give a warning), but you should be able to:

1) Call 'restore()' to rebuild R packages as needed for the new version of R, and
2) Call 'snapshot()' to record the (updated) version of R.

Note that packrat maintains version-specific library folders, so after updating to R 3.3.0 you'll need to reinstall packages for that project. (The older library of packages for R 3.2.2 will remain on disk, and would be used if you later used R 3.2.2 with that project again)

Thanks,
Kevin
